human_strengths: The paper proposes a framework that is generally applicable and mathematically elegant. The properties of the OT-regularized divergence are nice and the derived algorithm is nice. The paper is well-written and easy to read.
human_review_text: This paper proposed adversarial training with optimal-transport-regularized divergence. It is a framework solving distributional robustness optimization problem where the distributional divergence is regularized by optimal transport. The authors comprehensively study the properties of this problem and demonstrate the effectiveness of the derived algorithms.
